utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout — folks have been dropping off all kinds of tools and supplies. I’m going by later if you want me to check whether they still need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah? Are they still short on anything specific, or is it mostly covered now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not sure yet, but I can stop by and ask. If they’ve still got gaps, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll keep the plan moving with the neighbors. Let’s line up what needs fixing and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, sounds good — I’m a bit all over today, but I can help list what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep the list going and check who can bring tools or supplies. Just send me anything you notice needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great—could you start by checking what tools we still need and then swing by the hardware store?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check the tools we still need and head to the hardware store after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re shortest on tape, screws, and a couple of hand tools right now. If you can bring any of that, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring tape and a few screws this afternoon. I’ll check my toolbox for a couple hand tools too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times. What’s the schedule looking like?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally, I can work around that. I’ll draft a repair drive schedule with pickup and drop-off blocked off and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that’d help a lot. Once I see it, I can confirm what slots work for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to hear the plan first—what needs fixing, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still piecing it together, but I know we’ve got a few small fixes to tackle. I’ll check what’s needed and we can start as soon as I’ve got the list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—just let me know the list and a start time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, have you heard about the repair drive? I’m spreading the word fast, and you should definitely come by if you can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might, but I’d need to know the time and where people are meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall. I’ll make sure you’ve got the details, and I’d love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting going, but I’m still catching up on the details. What should I know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re starting by listing the most urgent fixes first, then matching each one with a volunteer or neighbor who can help. If you’ve got a repair need, tell me what it is and I’ll add it to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds helpful — I don’t have a repair need myself, but I can pass the word along and help keep track of what people mention.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help, but let me make sure I have the details right first — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — we’re starting at the community shed at 10, then splitting into small teams for the house fixes. I’ll bring the tool list and sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds clear — I’ve got 10 at the community shed, small teams for the house fixes, and you’re bringing the tool list and sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still trying to keep up with it, honestly. If you need me for the repair drive, just tell me what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll let you know what’s needed. I’m usually running late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Dane. Just send me the list when you can, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Mina — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Gus—what tools are you bringing, and what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my hammer, screwdriver set, and tape measure, and I can be there around 6 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m headed to the repair drive now — it’s at the community center parking lot, right by Elm and 4th. If you’re going, I can save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, sounds right — I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep an eye out for you near the community center lot by Elm and 4th.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’m still figuring out the list, but I’ll let you know what tools we need first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush — just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off is first. If we can sort the logistics, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot? Once I have that, I can tell you if it works.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just need the timing and exact drop-off spot before I can commit. Once I know those, I’ll tell you right away if it works.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I’ve got a couple neighbors who still need help, and I’ll send you their names right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, send them over and I’ll start matching folks up right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll note the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not totally sure what’s covered yet, but I can check in late and bring whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll keep a running list and wait for your update. If you find any gaps late, I can help make sure we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely — folks have been dropping off supplies all morning. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess — I’m trying to work around the school schedule, so knowing what’s still needed would really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — they still need a few hand tools, cleaning rags, and some batteries. I can also check what time the biggest drop-off rush is, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — what do you need me to fix or bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Bo — could you bring a drill, some screws, and a screwdriver? If you’ve got time, I’d also love help patching that loose fence panel on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring the drill, screws, and screwdriver. I can also help with the fence panel on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and set them by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and set them by the garage right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—want me to spread the word to the neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd really appreciate that. I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so any help getting the word out would be great.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll let the neighbors know today and point them to the details. If you want, I can also mention what supplies or help are most needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked anything yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening. If you want, I can help pin down the exact location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Opal. Let’s pin down the exact spot so I know where to head.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check for the exact address and nearby landmark, then I’ll let you know where to head.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — are we fixing the bikes first, or the tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s check which bikes need the most urgent repair first, then we can sort the tools after.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay — which bikes are most urgent?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right—the repair drive. I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can check around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira—that’d help a lot. I keep meaning to post the update, but I’ve been all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem—I’ll ask around and see what folks are saying. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know.
